subTitle: Straight answers about compliance, volume pricing, and how fast your order leaves our dock.

faqs.question: Are these ties approved for intermodal container security?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our 11-inch fluorescent tie is UL 21S listed and DOT compliant, and its length and tensile rating are sized for standard intermodal container locking mechanisms. If your terminal has a written seal specification, send it over and we will confirm the match in writing before you order.

faqs.question: How does volume pricing work?
faqs.answer: The discount is published on every product page and applies automatically at checkout. Order 1–99 packs and you pay retail; 100–199 packs drops the price roughly 11%; 200 packs or more drops it roughly 19%. There is no account to create, no minimum order, and no sales call in between.

faqs.question: Do mixed colors count toward the same volume tier?
faqs.answer: They do. Quantity is totaled across every color in your cart, so ordering 50 yellow and 50 pink reaches the 100-pack tier just as 100 yellow would.

faqs.question: When will my order ship?
faqs.answer: Orders placed before 5pm ET on a business day ship the next business day from stock. Custom and printed seals ship once production is complete — we confirm the lead time with your quote before you commit to the order.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the four colors?
faqs.answer: Nothing but the pigment. All four are the same 11-inch, 75-lb tensile, UL 21S listed tie. Fleets typically assign a color per lane, per shift, or per month so a broken seal is obvious at a glance. Fluorescent yellow is our highest-volume color and is priced as the lead-in SKU.

faqs.question: Can I get our logo or a serial number printed on the ties?
faqs.answer: Yes, on bulk orders. Send a bulk quote request with your artwork or numbering scheme and we will confirm pricing and lead time within one business day.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Unopened packs can be returned within 30 days for a full refund. If a tie fails to meet its published spec, tell us and we will replace the affected lot at our cost.
